title: Service accounts
description: Programmatic identities of the active workspace and their client credentials. Reveal shows the current secret, Rotate generates a new one and invalidates the previous one, and Revoke permanently disables the credential.

notice.tenantInactive: The organization is not active; write actions are disabled.
notice.readOnly: Read-only · your role ({role}) cannot create, rotate or revoke service accounts. {reason}

create.title: Create service account
create.help: A descriptive name to identify the service account. You can reveal or rotate its credential after creating it.

table.caption: Service accounts of the active workspace. Reveal shows the current client secret and can be used again; Rotate generates a new secret that replaces the previous one.
table.name: Name
table.credentialHelp: Reveal shows the current client secret and can be repeated. Rotate generates a new secret, replaces the previous one and invalidates tokens issued before the rotation.

row.revealHint: Shows the current client secret; it can be shown again.
row.revealRevoked: A revoked credential cannot be revealed.
row.rotateHint: Generates a new secret and replaces the previous one.
row.rotateRevoked: A revoked credential cannot be rotated.

rotate.title: Rotate the secret of {name}
rotate.description: Rotating replaces the previous secret and invalidates tokens issued before the rotation. Clients that use the previous secret will stop working.

revoke.title: Revoke the credential of {name}
revoke.description: The credential stops working immediately. Revocation is terminal: you will not be able to issue or rotate it again. To use this service account again, delete it and create a new one.

delete.title: Delete the service account {name}
delete.description: The Keycloak client and the service account record will be permanently deleted.

disclosure.revealDescription: This panel reveals the current client secret and can be shown again. Use Rotate to replace it and invalidate tokens issued with the previous secret.
disclosure.rotateDescription: Update your clients with this value. Rotating replaces the previous secret and invalidates tokens issued before the rotation.
disclosure.rotateWarningTitle: The previous secret is no longer valid
disclosure.rotateWarning: Tokens issued before the rotation were invalidated. Update your clients with this value.
disclosure.copyFallback: Could not copy automatically. Show the secret and select it to copy it.
